text: Created an interactive Streamlit dashboard implementing the Black-Scholes model to compute European call and put option prices under varying market conditions
Developed side-by-side interactive heatmaps visualizing option price sensitivity across user-defined spot price and volatility ranges for call versus put comparison

Designed customizable input controls for spot price, strike price, time to maturity, volatility, and risk-free rate, using pandas and NumPy for computation and Matplotlib and Seaborn for visualization
